name: unlock-fps
description: EXPERIMENTAL example mod: the game no longer waits for the next screen refresh before starting a frame. GT5's clock counts frames, so races run faster than real time whenever the frame rate goes over 60.

1535B865EC7DD58E7704B378B8621532ECF844E1.note: lwz r4,0x1C(r9) -> li r4,0: the frame pacer's wait interval becomes 0 (Europe 01.00; the same idea as RPCS3's patch for this game)
